title: Microsoft Edge: v.153 - Tracking prevention when browsing InPrivate
description: Microsoft Edge is unifying the tracking prevention experience for non-InPrivate and InPrivate browsing windows.  Microsoft Edge will use the same tracking prevention setting as a normal browsing window when in InPrivate mode.
